title: PH tourism creates jobs but draws less foreign spending

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tourism remains a critical source of employment in the Philippines, but the country still lags behind its Southeast Asian neighbors in attracting spending from international visitors, research by the World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) showed. The WTTC’s Economic Impact Research, released in April 2026 and analyzed by Inquirer data scientist Dr. Alicor Panao, showed that travel and tourism directly accounted for 14.2% of employment in the country in 2025, higher than the regional average of 7.3%.
